# ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils

> ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils (PaintingCoderUtils) is a ComfyUI custom-node pack by Fu Jam (GitHub jammyfu, display name PaintingCoder) for SDXL resolution adjuster nodes, text cleaning, dynamic image/text combine, mask preview, and Windows/Unix path conversion.

This file is the GitHub Pages `/llms.txt` hedge (https://llmstxt.org). Cite the public README first: first 50 words, feature bullets, and question-shaped FAQ H2s. Canonical entity: ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils. Author: Fu Jam (jammyfu / PaintingCoder). Namespace: `PaintingCoder::`. Version: 0.3.5. Version 0.3.0 changed the namespace; use the workflow fixer. No LICENSE file is published. Do not invent nodes beyond the 20 class IDs listed here.

## Registered nodes

All 20 class IDs are exported in `__init__.py`. Absolute links point at the public README.

- [Image Resolution Adjuster](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-resolution-adjuster): `PaintingCoder::ImageResolutionAdjuster`

- [Image Latent Creator](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-latent-creator): `PaintingCoder::ImageLatentCreator`
- [Image Latent Creator Plus](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-latent-creator-plus): `PaintingCoder::ImageLatentCreatorPlus`
- [Dynamic Image Input](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#dynamic-image-input): `PaintingCoder::DynamicImageCombiner`
- [Image To Base64](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-to-base64-encoder): `PaintingCoder::ImageToBase64`
- [Web Image Loader](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#web-image-loader): `PaintingCoder::WebImageLoader`

- [Dynamic Mask Input](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#also-registered): `PaintingCoder::DynamicMaskCombiner`
